items.body_excerpt:
The cheers Wednesday came with catharsis, as Blazers fans rooted on their sports hero once again — this time, with a new level of gratitude following his three-year-plus odyssey through Milwaukee and injury. 

All at once, the night evoked nostalgia for the past and excitement for the here and now.
